title: Implement Visual Category Discovery Pills and Craftsmanship Trust Bar
description: Build the circular category filter carousel inspired by India Circus (Wood, Metal, Ornate, Gallery, Minis) and the 4-column museum-grade trust assurance bar.
acceptanceCriteria: Visual filter pills carousel showcases circular timber/style thumbnails with smooth horizontal scroll
Clicking a category pill filters active featured frames or navigates to dedicated collections
Trust bar displays 4 core commitments: 100% Solid Hardwood, 4-Ply Archival Cotton, UV Conservation Acrylic, Hardware Included

steps.details: Create components/home/category-pills.tsx with touch-friendly carousel and active indicator.
Create components/home/trust-bar.tsx with refined iconography and hairline dividers.
Run Playwright test across mobile and desktop viewports.
